_doc: WARBOT legs (Robot.glb, the boxy white android chassis). World after import: Z up (0.3..1.95), X = width. Two stubby legs with flat feet hang under the body from z 0.3 to the hip joints at 0.65, outboard of |x| 0.15 (the pelvis ball and stem on the centre line stay with the body); the code-built arm cannons and face are scene nodes, not in the GLB. tools/blender/split_regions.py
